tasks.title: ngv2/sink_presence_gate.py -- pure deterministic sink-presence gate that verifies the cited vulnerable construct still exists as LIVE code before any NobleGreed 'confirmed' verdict
acceptance_criteria: NEW single-file module ngv2/sink_presence_gate.py is emitted whole-file (never a symbol patch) exposing the primary function with the exact signature verify_sink_present(target_source: str, expected_signature: str) -> dict.

The function is PURE and deterministic: it operates ONLY on the two string arguments (no filesystem, no network, no clock, no randomness, no subprocess, no MCP, no third-party import, no import of any sibling ngv2 leaf); identical inputs produce byte-identical output.

Returns a fixed-shape dict with EXACTLY the keys present (bool), status ('present' | 'patched_or_moved'), in_comment_only (bool), may_confirm (bool); status=='present' iff present and may_confirm==present.
(a) signature present VERBATIM in live code -> present=True, status='present', in_comment_only=False, may_confirm=True.
(b) signature ABSENT (patched/removed) -> present=False, status='patched_or_moved', in_comment_only=False, may_confirm=False.
(c) signature appears ONLY inside a # comment or a docstring/string-literal -> in_comment_only=True, present=False, status='patched_or_moved', may_confirm=False.
(d) signature present in live code but with DIFFERING insignificant whitespace/indentation -> present=True, status='present', may_confirm=True (whitespace normalized before matching).
The module is reachable/wired into the NobleGreed verdict path such that the verdict path consults may_confirm and refuses a 'confirmed' verdict when it is False.

The committed RED oracle tests/ngv2/test_sink_presence_gate_wired.py is GREEN: python3 -m pytest -q tests/ngv2/test_sink_presence_gate_wired.py passes; no new tests authored or existing tests modified.

spec.objective: Create the NEW pure, deterministic, stdlib-only module ngv2/sink_presence_gate.py exposing verify_sink_present(target_source, expected_signature) -> dict, which decides whether the cited vulnerable signature occurs as LIVE code (not only inside comments/string-literals/docstrings) in the target source, normalizing insignificant whitespace, and reports via may_confirm whether a NobleGreed 'confirmed' verdict may proceed. Make the committed oracle tests/ngv2/test_sink_presence_gate_wired.py GREEN.
functional_requirements: Emit the NEW single-file module ngv2/sink_presence_gate.py exposing verify_sink_present(target_source: str, expected_signature: str) -> dict; the function is PURE and deterministic, stdlib-only, operating ONLY on the two string arguments with no filesystem, network, clock, randomness, subprocess, MCP, third-party import, or import of any sibling ngv2 leaf, so identical inputs yield byte-identical output and the function is differential-fuzzable.

Return a fixed-shape dict with EXACTLY the keys present (bool), status (str, 'present' | 'patched_or_moved'), in_comment_only (bool), may_confirm (bool); status=='present' iff present else 'patched_or_moved', and may_confirm == present.

Matching logic: present is True iff expected_signature occurs in target_source as LIVE code (executable program text), and False when no live-code occurrence exists; classify in_comment_only=True iff the signature occurs in the source but EVERY occurrence is inside a comment / string-literal / docstring and never as live code.

Before matching, normalize insignificant whitespace and indentation differences between expected_signature and target_source so they do not defeat a live-code match (whitespace-normalized live occurrence still yields present=True).

Wire may_confirm into the NobleGreed verdict path via the single reachability/wired hook so the verdict path refuses a 'confirmed' verdict when may_confirm is False, satisfying the committed oracle tests/ngv2/test_sink_presence_gate_wired.py (make RED -> GREEN; author no new tests).
spec.interfaces: Primary function: verify_sink_present(target_source: str, expected_signature: str) -> dict, returning {present: bool, status: 'present'|'patched_or_moved', in_comment_only: bool, may_confirm: bool}. Pure stdlib-only module modelled on existing ngv2 pure recon helpers; no new dependency; reachable/wired into the existing NobleGreed verdict path that consults may_confirm.
edge_cases: (a) signature present verbatim in live code -> present=True, status='present', in_comment_only=False, may_confirm=True.
(b) signature absent / patched-out -> present=False, status='patched_or_moved', in_comment_only=False, may_confirm=False.
(c) signature only inside a # comment or docstring/string-literal -> in_comment_only=True, present=False, status='patched_or_moved', may_confirm=False.
(d) signature in live code but with differing insignificant whitespace/indentation -> present=True, status='present', may_confirm=True (normalized).

# COMMITTED ORACLE CONTRACT (authoritative; you cannot read these files at synthesis time so they are reproduced verbatim -- your code MUST make them pass):

## tests/ngv2/test_sink_presence_gate_wired.py
```python
"""RED oracle for ngv2.sink_presence_gate -- the deterministic gate that verifies
the cited vulnerable construct STILL EXISTS as LIVE code in the target source at
the pinned SHA before a NobleGreed "confirmed" verdict is allowed.

A PURE function operating ONLY on the two strings passed in (no filesystem,
network, clock, randomness, subprocess): verify_sink_present(target_source,
expected_signature) -> {present, status, in_comment_only, may_confirm}. A
signature found only inside comments / string-literals / docstrings is NOT live;
insignificant whitespace/indentation is normalized before matching; may_confirm
== present. Byte-stable determinism.

This oracle is the *_wired reachability proof: importing verify_sink_present from
the live ngv2.sink_presence_gate module is the wiring contract.
"""
import json

from ngv2.sink_presence_gate import verify_sink_present

RESULT_KEYS = {'present', 'status', 'in_comment_only', 'may_confirm'}


# --- contract: fixed-shape dict + status/may_confirm invariants ------------
def test_return_shape_contract():
    res = verify_sink_present('a = 1\n', 'a = 1')
    assert set(res) == RESULT_KEYS
    assert isinstance(res['present'], bool)
    assert isinstance(res['in_comment_only'], bool)
    assert isinstance(res['may_confirm'], bool)
    assert res['status'] in ('present', 'patched_or_moved')


def test_status_and_may_confirm_invariants_hold():
    samples = [
        ('def f():\n    user_input(req)\n', 'user_input(req)'),
        ('def f():\n    safe()\n', 'user_input(req)'),
        ('# user_input(req)\n', 'user_input(req)'),
    ]
    for src, sig in samples:
        res = verify_sink_present(src, sig)
        assert res['status'] == ('present' if res['present'] else 'patched_or_moved')
        assert res['may_confirm'] == res['present']


# --- (a) signature present verbatim in live code ---------------------------
def test_signature_present_verbatim_in_live_code():
    src = (
        'def handler(req):\n'
        '    return db.query("SELECT * FROM t WHERE id=" + req.id)\n'
    )
    res = verify_sink_present(src, 'db.query("SELECT * FROM t WHERE id=" + req.id)')
    assert res['present'] is True
    assert res['status'] == 'present'
    assert res['in_comment_only'] is False
    assert res['may_confirm'] is True


# --- (b) signature absent (patched/removed) -- the Flowise motivating cases-
def test_signature_absent_is_patched_or_moved():
    # the cited vulnerable construct no longer exists as live code at the pinned SHA
    src = (
        'function update(req, res) {\n'
        '  if (!checkAnyPermission(req)) return res.status(403)\n'
        '  Object.assign(safeFields, req.body)\n'
        '}\n'
    )
    res = verify_sink_present(src, 'Object.assign(entity, req.body)')
    assert res['present'] is False
    assert res['status'] == 'patched_or_moved'
    assert res['in_comment_only'] is False
    assert res['may_confirm'] is False


# --- (c) signature appears ONLY inside a comment or docstring --------------
def test_signature_in_comment_only_is_not_live():
    src = (
        'def handler(req):\n'
        '    # legacy: db.query("SELECT * FROM t WHERE id=" + req.id)\n'
        '    return db.safe_query(req.id)\n'
    )
    res = verify_sink_present(src, 'db.query("SELECT * FROM t WHERE id=" + req.id)')
    assert res['in_comment_only'] is True
    assert res['present'] is False
    assert res['status'] == 'patched_or_moved'
    assert res['may_confirm'] is False


def test_signature_in_docstring_only_is_not_live():
    src = (
        'def handler(req):\n'
        '    """Historically called db.query("DROP " + req.id) here."""\n'
        '    return None\n'
    )
    res = verify_sink_present(src, 'db.query("DROP " + req.id)')
    assert res['in_comment_only'] is True
    assert res['present'] is False
    assert res['may_confirm'] is False


# --- (d) live code with differing insignificant whitespace -> still present-
def test_whitespace_normalized_live_match_is_present():
    src = (
        'def handler(req):\n'
        '        return    db.query( "SELECT * FROM t WHERE id=" + req.id )\n'
    )
    # cited signature has single spaces; source has odd indentation/extra spaces
    res = verify_sink_present(src, 'db.query("SELECT * FROM t WHERE id=" + req.id)')
    assert res['present'] is True
    assert res['status'] == 'present'
    assert res['may_confirm'] is True


# --- determinism -----------------------------------------------------------
def test_output_is_byte_stable_deterministic():
    src = 'def f():\n    sink(user)\n'
    a = json.dumps(verify_sink_present(src, 'sink(user)'), sort_keys=True)
    b = json.dumps(verify_sink_present(src, 'sink(user)'), sort_keys=True)
    assert a == b

```
